milestones.title: Owner-local usable loop
milestones.definition: A real client completes a routine user-owned operation through Harness browser/local policy without Remote Desktop Commander on the critical path.

milestones.title: Private client-portable beta
milestones.definition: The same transport-neutral contract passes acceptance from the intended private clients without forking Browser Bridge or Local Executor semantics.

milestones.title: Public distribution ready
milestones.definition: Signed/public browser packages and public ChatGPT/plugin distribution satisfy their independent release and review requirements.
